name: Enterprise Ransomware Attack
description: A sophisticated ransomware operator has breached the network, performed reconnaissance, escalated privileges, and is now deploying ransomware across multiple systems. Shadow copies are being deleted and files are being encrypted.
objective: Detect and stop the ransomware deployment, preserve backups, isolate infected systems, and begin recovery procedures.

events.message: vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows /All /Quiet executed by SYSTEM - deleting volume shadow copies
Mass file encryption detected: 847 files renamed with .locked extension in D:\Finance\ in 10 seconds
Ransom note created: D:\Finance\README_DECRYPT.txt - contains payment instructions
Ransomware propagating via SMB: file-server-01 -> workstation-FIN-01, workstation-FIN-02
Backup server backup-server-01 accessed from infected host - attempting to encrypt backups

hints: vssadmin deleting shadow copies is a ransomware precursor — act immediately
Isolate affected systems from the network before ransomware spreads further
Protect the backup server at all costs — it's needed for recovery
Check if the backup server has been compromised before initiating restore
